ResearchProjectDef.label: shipboard firearms
ResearchProjectDef.description: Compact guns made for corridors, and frangible rounds that break apart instead of punching through the hull.

ResearchProjectDef.label: laser small arms
ResearchProjectDef.description: Recoilless laser pistols, carbines and rifles that work well in zero gravity.

ResearchProjectDef.label: plasma small arms
ResearchProjectDef.description: Hand-held plasma weapons: huge damage and a real danger to the hull.

ResearchProjectDef.label: rail small arms
ResearchProjectDef.description: Needle pistols, dart throwers and rail rifles that go through armor and thin walls.

ResearchProjectDef.label: boarding gear
ResearchProjectDef.description: Hull charges, foam and net launchers, stun weapons and special grenades for fighting inside ships.

ThingDef.label: shipboard pistol
ThingDef.description: A plain kinetic sidearm.

ThingDef.label: compact SMG
ThingDef.description: A short submachine gun for corridors.

ThingDef.label: crew carbine
ThingDef.description: The general-use carbine of ship crews.

ThingDef.label: boarding shotgun
ThingDef.description: A short shotgun with low-velocity shells.

ThingDef.label: precision rifle
ThingDef.description: A long rifle for planet-side shooting. Its rounds go through hull plating.

ThingDef.label: support machine gun
ThingDef.description: A belt-fed gun for suppression. Dangerous to the hull.

ThingDef.label: frangible pistol
ThingDef.description: Fires rounds that shatter on hard surfaces. Never breaks the hull.

ThingDef.label: frangible carbine
ThingDef.description: A carbine with frangible rounds for internal defense.

ThingDef.label: stunner
ThingDef.description: Stuns targets so they can be captured alive.

ThingDef.label: net launcher
ThingDef.description: Wraps the target in a sticky net that slows it down.

ThingDef.label: foam launcher
ThingDef.description: Shoots hardening foam that blocks a corridor, puts out fire and seals breaches.

ThingDef.label: laser pistol
ThingDef.description: A recoilless energy sidearm.

ThingDef.label: laser carbine
ThingDef.description: A general-use laser carbine that shines in zero gravity.

ThingDef.label: laser precision rifle
ThingDef.description: A long-range laser rifle.

ThingDef.label: pulse laser
ThingDef.description: A fast-firing laser that heats up quickly.

ThingDef.label: laser cutter
ThingDef.description: A cutting tool that doubles as a weapon. It cuts through hull walls by design.

ThingDef.label: plasma pistol
ThingDef.description: Short range, very high damage.

ThingDef.label: plasma thrower
ThingDef.description: Throws burning plasma over an area.

ThingDef.label: plasma rifle
ThingDef.description: An elite general-use plasma rifle.

ThingDef.label: portable plasma cannon
ThingDef.description: A heavy weapon carried by exosuits and strong soldiers.

ThingDef.label: needle pistol
ThingDef.description: A silent rail pistol that pierces armor.

ThingDef.label: rail rifle
ThingDef.description: Fires slugs that go through thin walls.

ThingDef.label: dart thrower
ThingDef.description: Fires darts loaded with poison or sedative.

ThingDef.label: heavy rail rifle
ThingDef.description: An anti-armor rail rifle.

ThingDef.label: shipboard grenade launcher
ThingDef.description: Fires low-power grenades.

ThingDef.label: light missile launcher
ThingDef.description: A shoulder launcher against shuttles and vehicles.

ThingDef.label: pulse grenades
ThingDef.description: Shut down electronics and shields. Never break the hull.

ThingDef.label: decompression grenades
ThingDef.description: Made to open a breach on purpose.

ThingDef.label: hull charge
ThingDef.description: A shaped charge that opens a way in during a boarding.

ThingDef.label: ship knife
ThingDef.description: A basic utility knife.

ThingDef.label: emergency axe
ThingDef.description: Also opens jammed doors.

ThingDef.label: shock baton
ThingDef.description: Stuns on hit.

ThingDef.label: vibro knife
ThingDef.description: A vibrating blade that pierces armor.

ThingDef.label: monomolecular blade
ThingDef.description: The best blade there is.

ThingDef.label: magnetic fist
ThingDef.description: Pushes the target away in zero gravity.

ThingDef.label: precursor relic weapon
ThingDef.description: A weapon of an extinct precursor civilization, found only in ruins. It fires an unstable beam whose power changes with every shot.
